name: YuliAI sell inventory live V3 quotation
summary: YuliAI's sellToken valued incoming YULIAI with a QuoterV2 quote against the live YULIAI/USDT Pancake V3 pool and paid that quote from its USDT inventory. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker pushed the pool price up, sold YULIAI to the contract in many calls at the inflated quote, then sold back into the pool.
notes: setToken(YULIAI) is the latest owner setter before the exploit and first made the sell path live; the fee tier and receiver were set earlier, and the later slot change is buyToken's live counter.
Loss nets the 5% sell fee the contract paid its owner (receiver EOA counted as victim); the YULIAI the attacker left in the contract is consideration and is not subtracted (rule 11).
